n. someone who causes the death of a person or animal
n. a difficulty that is hard to deal with
entry.zh:
n. (非正式)杀人者, 屠杀者, 猛兽, 致死(疾病), 杀手, 止痛药, 限制器, 瞄准器
[计] 删除程序; 断路器

entry.head: poet
entry.definition: n. a writer of poems (the term is usually reserved for writers of good poetry)
entry.zh: n. 诗人

entry.head: gang
entry.definition:
n. an association of criminals
n. an organized group of workmen
n. tool consisting of a combination of implements arranged to work together
v. act as an organized group
entry.zh:
n. 队, 群, 帮
vi. 成群结队, 结成一伙
vt. 使成群结队

entry.head: johnson
entry.definition:
n. English writer and lexicographer (1709-1784)
n. 36th President of the United States; was elected vice president and succeeded Kennedy when Kennedy was assassinated (1908-1973)
n. 17th President of the United States; was elected vice president and succeeded Lincoln when Lincoln was assassinated; was impeached but acquitted by one vote (1808-1875)
entry.zh: n. 约翰逊（姓氏）

entry.head: supplier
entry.definition: n. someone whose business is to supply a particular service or commodity
entry.zh:
n. 供应者, 供给国, 供应商
[化] 承制厂; 供应厂商

entry.head: classic
entry.definition:
n. a creation of the highest excellence
n. an artist who has created classic works
entry.zh:
n. 古典作品, 杰作, 大艺术家
a. 第一流的, 最优秀的, 古典的

entry.head: scott
entry.definition:
n. award-winning United States film actor (1928-1999)
n. English explorer who reached the South Pole just a month after Amundsen; he and his party died on the return journey (1868-1912)
n. United States general who was a hero of the War of 1812 and who defeated Santa Anna in the Mexican War (1786-1866)
